verdict.rationale: Groq's docs position the product as 'Fast LLM inference' and offer service tiers to tune for latency and throughput, a high-throughput Flex tier, and streaming. Independent hands-on reports measured roughly 450–490 tokens/sec on Mixtral and about 200 tps on Llama 2 70B, and Groq staff describe low-latency, queue-free serving even at batch size 1. Reliability complaints and vague price/performance gripes do not concretely contradict the speed claims. Missing for 10: quantified time-to-first-token measurements, first-party latency/throughput benchmarks or SLAs, recent independent speed corroboration on current models.
